name: Eden Roc Cap Cana
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary offers the Dominican Republic's most exclusive slice of paradise, where Relais & Châteaux luxury meets Caribbean soul.
whats_special: Eden Roc Cap Cana is dramatically perched on limestone bluffs 40 feet above the Caribbean Sea, making it the only resort in Punta Cana with natural clifftop pools carved from ancient coral stone. The property sits within Cap Cana, an exclusive 30,000-acre resort community that's home to the Caribbean's first Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course and the region's deepest-water marina.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the cliff side for unobstructed ocean views and direct access to the natural rock pools - these are the most coveted accommodations and often sell out months in advance.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature clifftop infinity pools that blend seamlessly with the horizon, and a sunset dinner at their oceanfront restaurant where you can spot migrating humpback whales (January through March). The nearby Hoyo Azul cenote, a hidden natural swimming hole surrounded by 75-foot cliffs, is just a 10-minute drive away.
pros: Adults-only luxury resort with sophisticated atmosphere
Stunning oceanfront location in exclusive Cap Cana
Relais & Châteaux member with exceptional service standards
Private beach access and premium amenities
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
